findings.evidence: Lines 214-226 contain a 13-line `have hset : rimHookSubdiagrams (diagramOf μ) r = Finset.image (diagramOf (n := l.sum)) {ν : l.sum.Partition | (diagramOf μ).IsRimHook (diagramOf ν)}` whose proof uses only `mem_rimHookSubdiagrams`, `card_diagramOf`, `toPartition`/`diagramOf_toPartition` — nothing from the ambient induction.
findings.fix: Extract it as a top-level lemma next to `mem_rimHookSubdiagrams`, e.g. `theorem rimHookSubdiagrams_eq_image {μ : YoungDiagram} {n r : ℕ} (h : n + r = μ.card) : rimHookSubdiagrams μ r = Finset.image (diagramOf (n := n)) {ν : n.Partition | μ.IsRimHook (diagramOf ν)}` (the existing proof, with `card_diagramOf` replaced by `h`), and call it in `hR`. While there, name the summand once rather than repeating the 4-line `if ... IsRimHook ... then ((-1) ^ ... * ...) • schurPoly σ R μ else 0` verbatim in both `hL` (193-196) and `hR` (209-212).
findings.issue: `hset` (lines 214-226) is a reusable lemma hidden inside `prod_map_psum_eq_sum_smul_schurPoly`: it is the only bridge from the `Finset YoungDiagram` index set `rimHookSubdiagrams` to the `Fintype` of partitions, so every future manipulation of `murnaghanNakayamaCoeff` (notably the character identification the module docstring defers) must re-prove it. It is also what pushes the proof body to ~60 lines.

findings.evidence: Grep for `card_bot|card_eq_zero|eq_bot_iff` in `code/TauCeti/Combinatorics/Young` returns only `HookLength/Formula.lean:186: have hcells : μ.cells = ∅ := Finset.card_eq_zero.mp hcard` — the same derivation already duplicated once pre-PR; grep for `Partition 0|Unique|bot` in `Partitions.lean` returns no matches, so no `diagramOf _ = ⊥` lemma exists.
findings.fix: Add `YoungDiagram.card_bot` and `YoungDiagram.card_eq_zero_iff : μ.card = 0 ↔ μ = ⊥` to `TauCeti/Combinatorics/Young/Diagram.lean` (which already collects `rowLen_bot`, `colLen_bot`), and `diagramOf_eq_bot (μ : Nat.Partition 0) : diagramOf μ = ⊥` to `TauCeti/Combinatorics/Young/Partitions.lean`; use them here.
findings.issue: Two reusable Young-diagram facts are re-derived inline: `hbc : (⊥ : YoungDiagram).card = 0` via `Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr YoungDiagram.cells_bot` (line 147), and `hbot : diagramOf (default : Nat.Partition 0) = ⊥` via `YoungDiagram.ext ((Finset.card_eq_zero.mp (card_diagramOf _)).trans YoungDiagram.cells_bot.symm)` (lines 178-180). The second is stated only for `default`, so it is unusable for an arbitrary `Nat.Partition 0`.

summary: The proofs are automation-friendly and free of `change`/`show` or defeq tricks, but the 60-line main proof buries the one genuinely reusable lemma (the identification of `rimHookSubdiagrams` with an image of a partition filter) in a `have`, and two `⊥`-related facts are re-derived inline instead of being added to the Young-diagram API.
